response.sql: WITH order_averages AS (SELECT COALESCE(ordersmark, '') AS order_key, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_unfilled FROM orderexecutions WHERE remaincount IS NOT NULL GROUP BY COALESCE(ordersmark, '')), overall AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS avg_unfilled FROM order_averages), above_overall AS (SELECT a.order_key, a.avg_unfilled, a.avg_unfilled - o.avg_unfilled AS excess_overall FROM order_averages a CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE a.avg_unfilled > o.avg_unfilled), group_average AS (SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled) AS avg_unfilled FROM above_overall), qualifying AS (SELECT a.avg_unfilled, a.excess_overall, a.avg_unfilled - g.avg_unfilled AS excess_group FROM above_overall a CROSS JOIN group_average g WHERE a.avg_unfilled > g.avg_unfilled) SELECT AVG(avg_unfilled), AVG(excess_overall), AVG(excess_group) FROM qualifying;
